summary: CloudIVR end-to-end test for the nav merge (5 sidebar groups / 13 links), hub tabs, Emily-first layouts, number-search provider routing and SignalWire-full suppression. Backend unit suites (test_number_supply_2026-11.js and test_sip_badge_sweep_feed.js) both pass. Area-code searches (667/225/501/212) all return MultiTEL numbers starting with +1<areaCode>, fallback null. Unknown areaCode (310) correctly returns other California numbers with fallback {areaCode:'310',region:'CA'}. Sidebar nav, every hub page's tabs, and the detail pages (no hub tabs on /app/numbers/<num>, /app/ai-agents/<id>, /app/campaigns/new) all check out. All 12 old direct URLs still load (HTTP 200). Emily panel is first and correctly before the fold on receptionist/new, ai-agents edit, forwarding tab and quick-call. Forwarding chat flow and save/restore work. Found 2 real issues: (1) Quick-call empty submit does NOT open the fold or show an error (spec said it must do both). (2) New receptionist save with empty name DOES open the fold but surfaces no visible error (spec said it must show the error). Minor spec deviation: [data-testid='app-sidebar'] wrapper is missing — the nav-* testids themselves do exist and are clickable, so nothing is broken for users.

ui_bugs.issue: Pressing 'Place call' with the form empty does not open the fold-quick FormFold and no [data-testid=quick-call-error] is rendered. The fold's open prop is {!!f.targets}; nothing triggers it on submit error. Spec in /app/frontend/src/cloudivr/pages/QuickCall.js line 165 — add a submit-error state that forces the fold open and renders a visible error, and send the user's focus to the first empty field.

Saving with an empty name while the fold is closed DOES open the fold (good) but no visible error is surfaced (no [role=alert], no toast, no red text, aria-invalid not set). Spec said it must 'surface the error and open the fold (not fail silently)'. Show an inline error under ai-agent-name-input and/or a toast when save validation fails.

[data-testid='app-sidebar'] wrapper not present. The individual nav-* links exist and all work (14 clickable items including nav-browser-phone), but the sidebar container lacks the testid called out in the spec.

passed_checks: Login flow with cookie-allow-all + email/password lands on /cloudivr/app

All 14 nav-* links present and navigate without runtime error: nav-dashboard, nav-messages, nav-numbers, nav-buy, nav-esim, nav-fax, nav-calls, nav-campaigns, nav-contacts, nav-browser-phone, nav-ai, nav-wallet, nav-settings, nav-help
Every hub has its full tab set: numbers (5), messages (2), esim (2), fax (2), quick-call (2), campaigns (2), contacts (3), receptionist (2), wallet (2)
Detail pages (/app/numbers/%2B13341112222, /app/ai-agents/<id>, /app/campaigns/new) do NOT render hub-tabs-* (as required)

All 12 old direct URLs still load HTTP 200: /app/sip, /app/answer/ivr, /app/lookup, /app/audio, /app/do-not-call, /app/live, /app/text-call, /app/travel-esim, /app/texting, /app/renewals, /app/inbox, /app/ai-agents

/app/receptionist/new: Emily panel (ai-builder-chat, title 'Emily sets up your receptionist') is before the fold in the DOM; 3 example chips, input, send exist; fold starts data-open='no'; toggle opens it and shows ai-agent-name-input; Save button is visible with the fold closed
Empty-name save on receptionist/new opens the fold automatically (though no visible error — see bug above)
/app/ai-agents/<id> edit: Emily on top, fold already data-open='yes' with name 'Sales AI' populated

Number +13341112222 forwarding tab: Emily title 'Emily · Set this up by chatting', fold-forwarding data-open='no' while off, toggle opens it, manual mode switch exists; save forwarding (mode=always, +14155550100) persisted; then restored to Off and API GET /numbers/%2B13341112222 confirms forwarding: null
/app/quick-call: Emily panel + fold-quick + submit button + open-phone button all render
Home /app renders stats, numbers list, dashboard-more-toggle, home-tasks; setup-checklist dismissed on this account (expected behavior)

Mobile 390x844: mobile-bottom-nav has 5 entries (Home, Numbers, Inbox w/ unread badge, Wallet, More); no horizontal page overflow on home, /receptionist/new or /numbers; hub-tabs-numbers is horizontally scrollable
Backend GET /numbers/search?country=US&type=local&areaCode=667|225|501|212: all 12-number responses START with the right +1<areaCode> prefix, provider='multitel', fallback=null
Backend GET without areaCode: 200 with results; areaCode=310 (unknown) returns 12 California fallback numbers with {areaCode:'310',region:'CA'} — spec-allowed
node /app/js/tests/test_number_supply_2026-11.js: 4/4 passed (US/CA area-code map, SignalWire full-flag flow, 6h admin alert)
action_items: QuickCall.js: when go() submit fails validation (no targets etc.), force FormFold open (pass a submitError state into open) and render a visible error via ErrorNote or a toast; today the user is left with no feedback
AgentForm (receptionist/new): on empty-name save, surface a visible error (inline field error or toast) in addition to auto-opening the fold
Add data-testid='app-sidebar' to the desktop sidebar wrapper (purely to match spec — nothing user-visible broken)
critical_code_review_comments: QuickCall.go() catches error, calls emilyEvent('applied','quick'), and sets setError(err); ErrorNote should render but [data-testid=quick-call-error] came back null in the DOM after an empty POST — check that ErrorNote actually emits the testid when error is a plain Error or a non-object
FormFold open={!!f.targets} couples visibility to a single field; consider open={!!f.targets || submitError} so validation always reveals the fields

success_rate.frontend: ~92% (nav, hubs, Emily layout, forwarding, mobile all pass; empty-submit error feedback missing in 2 places)

seed_data_creation: Temporarily changed forwarding on +13341112222 to Always → +14155550100, then restored to Off (API confirms forwarding: null). No new users, agents, receptionists, campaigns or numbers were created. No real calls were placed and no numbers were bought.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login = cookie-allow-all then civr.uxtest@example.com / UxTest#2026. Session cookie is civr_session. All nav-*, hub-tab-*, fold-*, ai-builder-* and forwarding-* testids used in this iteration are live. Forwarding on +13341112222 is Off. SignalWire-full flag is cleared by the unit test; state is still server-held between runs. The Emily LLM endpoints (/assist/:screen and /ai-agents/builder-chat) were NOT exercised in this run to save runtime — worth a quick send-and-apply check next time (iteration 317 did this).
